items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I hung out with Jimmy Monroe, and we went to the consulate... he helped me leave

ctx.x: Oh, first of all... I got to Paris first. Before I left out of Paris, Billie Holiday's ex-husband, Jimmy Monroe, was there. I met him. And the streets were clean, just like... I don't know Casablanca ever got that atmosphere (?)about Paris, getting out of Paris, but that was... For me, that was like a background! It was clean, the streets were... People were leaving the city. It wasn't the Paris that I knew. I hung out with Jimmy Monroe, and we went to the consulate, where... Well, he helped me leave; you know,…

So one night we took the train, quietly, out of the Gare St. Lazare. I remember the night ride all through, going through... I didn't know if a bomb was coming or not! But anyhow, the next day we arrived. I wouldn't get off the train to see old friends or anything, because this was my last chance -- I wanted to get the hell out!
